description: This file defines an abstract class AntlrLexer for lexical analysis in a parser framework, including methods for tokenizing input streams, error handling, and lexer state management.

classes.name: AntlrLexer
classes.description: Abstract base class for lexers in the parsing framework, handling tokenization, error reporting, and input stream management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the lexer with an input stream and optional shared state.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the lexer state and input stream to start tokenization anew.

methods.name: nextToken
methods.description: Generates the next token from the input stream by invoking lexical rules.

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Instructs the lexer to skip creating a token for the current rule and proceed.

methods.name: setCharStream
methods.description: Assigns a new input stream to the lexer and resets its state.

methods.name: getCharStream
methods.description: Returns the current input stream.

methods.name: getSourceName
methods.description: Retrieves the source name of the input stream.

methods.name: emit
methods.description: Creates and returns a token based on the current lexer state.

methods.name: matchString
methods.description: Matches a specific string in the input stream, throwing an exception if mismatched.

methods.name: matchAny
methods.description: Consumes a single character from the input stream.

methods.name: matchChar
methods.description: Matches a specific character from the input stream.

methods.name: matchRange
methods.description: Matches a character within a specified range.

methods.name: getLine
methods.description: Returns the current line number in the input.

methods.name: getCharPositionInLine
methods.description: Returns the character position in the current line.

methods.name: getCharIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the current character in the input stream.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text matched so far for the current token or override.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Overrides the text for the current token.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Handles error reporting for recognition exceptions.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Provides a descriptive message for recognition exceptions.

methods.name: getCharErrorDisplay
methods.description: Formats a character for display in error messages.

methods.name: recover
methods.description: Attempts to recover from an error during lexing.

methods.name: traceIn
methods.description: Logs entry into a parsing rule for debugging.

methods.name: traceOut
methods.description: Logs exit from a parsing rule for debugging.
